summary.text: Your monthly payout depends on your RA savings and the age you start. The maximum is $3,440 at 65 or $4,580 at 70.

details.heading: Maximum CPF LIFE payout
details.body: You can receive up to $3,440 each month for life from age 65. If you start at age 70, you can receive up to $4,580 each month.

details.heading: Examples from age 65
details.body: With $50,000 in your RA at age 55, the monthly payout from age 65 is $490. With $110,200, it is $950. With $220,400, it is $1,780.

details.heading: If you are not on CPF LIFE
details.body: You will receive at least $350 each month until your CPF savings run out.

sources.page_title: How much CPF payouts can I get every month?

quotes.text: Your monthly payout amount depends on the amount of savings in your Retirement Account (RA) and your age at the point you start your payouts.

Under CPF LIFE, you can receive up to $3,440 per month for life starting from age 65. For each year that you defer, your payouts will increase by up to 7%. This means that you can receive up to $4,580 if you choose to start your payout at age 70.
If you are not under CPF LIFE, you will receive monthly payouts of at least $350 until your CPF savings are depleted.
